decisions.reason: The repeated gold-medal recognition in 2023 and 2024 shows this close-to-core seasonal product has already demonstrated value, so its option has resolved positively and the firm is very likely to keep it.

Because this bread variant remained while several other 2023 bread experiments were removed, management is likely to view it as a viable low-cost extension of the core range worth keeping on the market.

This marzipan stollen fits the established holiday business and appears inexpensive to carry, so without clear negative evidence a traditional German bakery would likely keep it despite somewhat more uncertain prospects than the award-winning raisin stollen.
